specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_study
specs.doc: Create a topology optimization study (analysis type 13) on the ACTIVE part. Topology optimization works on ONE single-body part at a time (official limit). Returns which entry point was used (CreateNewStudy3, or a fallback).
specs.title: Create SOLIDWORKS Topology Study

specs.name: solidworks_topology_evidence
specs.doc: Read back the topology studies on the active document: names, analysis types, and which constraints/controls exist. Read-only.
specs.title: Collect SOLIDWORKS Topology Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_topology_run
specs.doc: Mesh and solve the topology study and report whether results exist. A zero RunAnalysis return code does NOT mean success - judge by study results.
specs.title: Run SOLIDWORKS Topology Study

specs.name: solidworks_mold_parting_line
specs.doc: Insert a mold parting line. Select the draft-direction reference first (edge/plane/axis); without it the call inserts nothing.
specs.title: Insert Mold Parting Line

specs.name: solidworks_mold_shut_off_surface
specs.doc: Auto-create shut-off surfaces over holes for mold separation. Zero parameters.
specs.title: Insert Mold Shut-off Surface

specs.name: solidworks_mold_draft_analysis
specs.doc: Run mold draft analysis. Returns the official return code as-is: that code has NO published enum, so this tool does NOT judge success from it.
specs.title: Run Mold Draft Analysis

specs.name: solidworks_mold_evidence
specs.doc: Read back the mold state of the active part: parting-line/surface and cavity/core surface counts, parting type, core-cavity split. Read-only.
specs.title: Collect Mold Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_set_material
specs.doc: Assign a material to the active part and RETURN THE READ-BACK MaterialIdName. An empty string means it did NOT take effect (the API itself returns void).
specs.title: Set Part Material

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_evidence
specs.doc: Read back the weldment state: structural members, cut-list folders, and their quantity/length/angle/source properties. Read-only when create_missing_cut_list is False.
specs.title: Collect Weldment Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_ensure_cut_list
specs.doc: Create the cut list if it is missing, and return the cut-list folders.
specs.title: Ensure Weldment Cut List

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_update_cut_list
specs.doc: Refresh the cut list and return the updated folders.
specs.title: Update Weldment Cut List

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_create_sub_weld_folder
specs.doc: Create a sub-weldment folder in the active weldment part.
specs.title: Create Sub-weldment Folder

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_evidence
specs.doc: Read back the sheet-metal state of the active part: thickness, bend radius, bend allowance settings, flat-pattern state. Read-only. VERIFIED ON A REAL MACHINE: run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it read back correctly (thickness_m=0.002, has_base_flange=True, all_solid_bodies_are_sheet_metal=True).
specs.title: Collect Sheet Metal Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_surface_evidence
specs.doc: Read back the surface bodies on the active document: counts and types. Read-only.
specs.title: Collect Surface Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_create_base_flange
specs.doc: Create a native base flange (swFmBaseFlange) from an open or closed sketch. An open polyline path produces a profile flange; a closed contour produces a flat plate. Returns the real IFeature; failures raise instead of returning empty. VERIFIED ON A REAL MACHINE: run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it WORKED (the feature tree showed the sheet-metal feature).
specs.title: Create Sheet Metal Base Flange

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_create_one_bend
specs.doc: Create a single sheet-metal bend on the selected sketch. *** NOT USABLE ON THE TEST MACHINE *** run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it FAILED with: CreateDefinition(33) returned None. The correct call shape has not been determined yet - see scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS. The tool is kept so the failure stays diagnosable, not because it works.
specs.title: Create Sheet Metal One Bend

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_create_edge_flange
specs.doc: Create a native edge flange on a SELECTED edge. The edge is selected for you from `selection` BEFORE the call (the implementation requires a pre-existing selection). *** NOT USABLE ON THE TEST MACHINE *** run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it FAILED with: setting `ReverseDirection` gave `Property ... can not be set`. The correct call shape has not been determined yet - see scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS. The tool is kept so the failure stays diagnosable, not because it works.
specs.title: Create Sheet Metal Edge Flange

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_create_gusset
specs.doc: Create a native sheet-metal gusset on a SELECTED supporting face. The face is selected for you from `selection` BEFORE the call. *** NOT USABLE ON THE TEST MACHINE *** run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it FAILED with: setting `Thickness` gave `Property ... can not be set`. The correct call shape has not been determined yet - see scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS. The tool is kept so the failure stays diagnosable, not because it works.
specs.title: Create Sheet Metal Gusset

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_create_draft
specs.doc: Create a native draft on a SELECTED face. NOTE: the implementation's own `face_ref` parameter is accepted but NEVER USED (verified by reading the body); this tool therefore omits it and selects from `selection` instead, matching the docstring ('on the already-selected face'). *** NOT USABLE ON THE TEST MACHINE *** run 2026-10-01 on SW 2026 SP4.1 and it FAILED with: CreateDefinition(3) returned None. The correct call shape has not been determined yet - see scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS. The tool is kept so the failure stays diagnosable, not because it works.
specs.title: Create Sheet Metal Draft

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_create_swept_flange
specs.doc: Create a native swept flange along a path. REQUIRES an existing base flange first (the official example builds one before the swept flange) - otherwise there is no thickness to inherit. NOT YET TESTED ON A REAL MACHINE: it needs both a sweep path and a profile selection, which the 2026-10-01 probe did not build. See scripts/sw_sheet_metal.py::SHEET_METAL_RUNTIME_STATUS before relying on it.
specs.title: Create Sheet Metal Swept Flange

specs.name: solidworks_current_selection
specs.doc: Read the current selection set (optionally filtered to one selection mark).
specs.title: Current Selection

specs.name: solidworks_clear_selection
specs.doc: Clear the current selection set.
specs.title: Clear Selection

specs.name: solidworks_set_standard_view
specs.doc: Switch the model to a named standard view (e.g. isometric, front, top).
specs.title: Set Standard View

specs.name: solidworks_list_render_materials
specs.doc: List the render materials available in the active document.
specs.title: List Render Materials

specs.name: solidworks_collect_appearance_evidence
specs.doc: Collect appearance evidence for the active document (read-only, for verification).
specs.title: Collect Appearance Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_available_point_selectors
specs.doc: List the point-selector names usable when specifying geometry (no document needed).
specs.title: Available Point Selectors

specs.name: solidworks_available_direction_selectors
specs.doc: List the direction-selector names usable when specifying geometry (no document needed).
specs.title: Available Direction Selectors

specs.name: solidworks_collect_assembly_bom
specs.doc: Read the assembly BOM as structured rows (the CSV-export tool is a different one).
specs.title: Collect Assembly BOM

specs.name: solidworks_activate_model_for_preview
specs.doc: Activate the model for preview/review (prepares the document for capture). ⚠ May mark the document as modified (view/selection state changes count).
specs.title: Activate Model For Preview

specs.name: solidworks_clear_selection_for_preview
specs.doc: Clear the selection so the preview does not show highlighted entities. ⚠ May mark the document as modified (view/selection state changes count).
specs.title: Clear Selection For Preview

specs.name: solidworks_refresh_scene_graph
specs.doc: Refresh the graphics/scene graph, e.g. after an appearance change. ⚠ May mark the document as modified (view/selection state changes count).
specs.title: Refresh Scene Graph

specs.name: solidworks_collect_model_summary
specs.doc: Summarise the model: title, type, feature tree (name + type), save path.
specs.title: Collect Model Summary

specs.name: solidworks_get_costing_manager
specs.doc: Get the SOLIDWORKS Costing manager object for the active document.
specs.title: Get Costing Manager

specs.name: solidworks_list_simulation_study_options
specs.doc: List the simulation study option setters available (no document needed).
specs.title: List Simulation Study Options

specs.name: solidworks_mold_core_cavity_split
specs.doc: Split the mold into core and cavity solids (this is the tooling split). ⚠ 0.0 means 'use the document default' for scale/thickness/offset.
specs.title: Insert Mold Core/Cavity Split

specs.name: solidworks_mold_parting_surface
specs.doc: Insert the mold parting surface.
specs.title: Insert Mold Parting Surface

specs.name: solidworks_mold_undercut_detect
specs.doc: Detect mold undercuts along a direction. ⚠ The underlying IFeatureManager.MoldUndercutDetect is marked Obsolete by SOLIDWORKS (successor: MoldUndercutDetect2); kept deliberately until the successor shape is verified. See docs/obsolete-member-candidates.md. ★★ Parameter names now follow the official md (ColUndercut/ColBase/BCoordInput/Dx/Dy/Dz); the earlier names (direction/option/include_hidden/a/b/c) did not, so the third argument BCoordInput received False — which drops back to 'use the model's own draft direction' and pops the modal 「此拔模方向尚未定义。」 on a part without one, stalling the session.
specs.title: Detect Mold Undercuts

specs.name: solidworks_part_bounding_box
specs.doc: Get the bounding box of the first solid body. ⚠⚠ SOLIDWORKS documents the returned values as APPROXIMATE and says they 'should not be used for comparison or calculation purposes'; the box may also vary after a rebuild. Use this for a rough overview only. ⚠ Units are MILLIMETRES (measured on SW 2026 SP4.1: an 80x60x50 mm box returns 80/60/50, not 0.08/0.06/0.05).
specs.title: Get Part Bounding Box

specs.name: solidworks_hole_standards
specs.doc: List the Hole Wizard standards available for a hole type (official ISldWorks.GetHoleStandardsData + IHoleStandardsData.GetHoleStandards). Returns [{id, name}, ...]; the two out parameters are paired positionally. ⚠ Officially returns null when hole_type_id is 5 (swWzdLegacy).
specs.title: List Hole Wizard Standards

specs.name: solidworks_fastener_types
specs.doc: List the fastener types under a Hole Wizard standard. Returns [{id, name}, ...]. ⚠ The names follow the SOLIDWORKS UI language (a Chinese UI returns Chinese names); do not assume English. Use an id from this list as fastener_id elsewhere. ⚠ Internally the IHoleStandardsData object must be primed with GetHoleStandards first, otherwise SOLIDWORKS returns False (measured); this function does that.
specs.title: List Hole Wizard Fastener Types

specs.name: solidworks_fastener_table_types
specs.doc: List the fastener table type ids for one fastener (official IHoleStandardsData.GetFastenerTableTypes). ⚠ The official second parameter is an Int32 FASTENER ID (from solidworks_fastener_types), not a size name - passing a size name raises a type-mismatch error. Returns a list of ints.
specs.title: List Hole Wizard Fastener Table Types

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_mass_constraint
specs.doc: Create a mass constraint for a topology study (mass-reduction percent semantics). Returns the constraint object.
specs.title: Create Topology Mass Constraint

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_factor_of_safety_constraint
specs.doc: Create a factor-of-safety constraint for a topology study (stress must stay below that percentage of yield strength).
specs.title: Create Topology Factor-of-Safety Constraint

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_preserved_region
specs.doc: Create a preserved region for a topology study (material that must not be removed). ⚠ `option` is an official enum value; omit to use the default.
specs.title: Create Topology Preserved Region

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_thickness_control
specs.doc: Create a thickness control for a topology study (minimum/maximum thickness). Units are millimetres (rule 2).
specs.title: Create Topology Thickness Control

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_demold_control
specs.doc: Create a de-mold (manufacturing) control for a topology study. The caller must first select the pull-direction face/edge/plane, then choose the direction option.
specs.title: Create Topology Demold Control

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_stress_constraint
specs.doc: Create a stress constraint for a topology study.
specs.title: Create Topology Stress Constraint

specs.name: solidworks_topology_create_symmetry_control
specs.doc: Create a symmetry control for a topology study. The caller must first select the symmetry plane(s).
specs.title: Create Topology Symmetry Control

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_generate_report
specs.doc: Generate a study report to a file. ⚠ `template` valid values were NOT found in the local sources (see the batch header); pass the template name your SolidWorks installation provides.
specs.title: Generate Simulation Study Report

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_create_mesh_for_control
specs.doc: Mesh the study using a named mesh control.
specs.title: Create Simulation Mesh For Mesh Control

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_default_element_size_and_tolerance
specs.doc: Get the suggested element size and tolerance (millimetre-scale when units=-1).
specs.title: Get Simulation Default Element Size And Tolerance

specs.name: solidworks_get_active_view
specs.doc: Get the currently active 3D view (the official member is IModelDoc.ActiveView).
specs.title: Get Active View

specs.name: solidworks_entities_on_body
specs.doc: List the entities of one body (kind EDGE, FACE, or VERTEX). ⚠ Index order is NOT promised stable by the official API — do not treat body_index as a persistent reference across rebuilds.
specs.title: List Entities On Body

specs.name: solidworks_build_review_report
specs.doc: Build structured review-report data (exports preview images and writes a report into output_dir). ⚠ The optional `views` / `expected_outputs` list parameters are NOT exposed in this tool — see the batch header for why.
specs.title: Build Review Report

specs.name: solidworks_add_sketch_relation
specs.doc: Add a sketch geometric relation to the current selection.
specs.title: Add Sketch Relation

specs.name: solidworks_mirror_feature
specs.doc: Mirror an existing feature about a plane.
specs.title: Mirror Feature

specs.name: solidworks_circular_pattern
specs.doc: Create a circular pattern about an axis.
specs.title: Create Circular Pattern

specs.name: solidworks_revolve_boss
specs.doc: Revolve a profile sketch into a boss feature. ⚠ This call is routed through a closed-source COM backend — see docs/known-facts.md.
specs.title: Create Revolve Boss

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_count_lines
specs.doc: Count the straight LINES in a sketch. ⚠ Use this rather than the raw getter: the underlying ISketch call returns a NUMBER array (12 floats per line), which cannot answer "how many lines".
specs.title: Count Sketch Lines

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_count_arcs
specs.doc: Count the ARCS in a sketch (the underlying call returns 16 floats per arc). ⚠ A full CIRCLE counts as ONE arc — verified on a real machine (2026-10-01): a sketch with 1 line + 1 circle reports count_lines=1, count_arcs=1, count_segments=2.
specs.title: Count Sketch Arcs

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_count_segments
specs.doc: Count ALL segments in a sketch. ⚠ Not the same as the line count: segments are the total geometry units; lines are one kind among them.
specs.title: Count Sketch Segments

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_is_3d
specs.doc: Whether the sketch is a 3D sketch (ISketch.Is3D).
specs.title: Is 3D Sketch

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_start
specs.doc: Enter a new sketch on a reference plane. ★ This is the prerequisite for every sketch-based feature (extrude, revolve, hole, sheet-metal flange).
specs.title: Start a Sketch

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_end
specs.doc: Leave the current sketch. ★ The resulting sketch reference is reusable by solidworks_extrude_* and other feature tools, so features can be built right after.
specs.title: End the Sketch

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_add_line
specs.title: Add a Line to the Sketch

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_add_circle
specs.title: Add a Circle to the Sketch

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_add_rectangle
specs.title: Add a Rectangle to the Sketch (two opposite corners)

specs.name: solidworks_extrude_boss
specs.doc: Extrude a sketch into a solid BOSS (adds material). ★ This is the first tool in the repo that turns a sketch into a solid body.
specs.title: Extrude a Boss (add material)

specs.name: solidworks_extrude_cut
specs.doc: Extrude a sketch as a CUT (removes material). ★ depth_mm = 0 means through-all. ⚠ The correct entry point for a cut is FeatureCut4, not FeatureExtrusion3 with flip=True — the capability layer already handles that.
specs.title: Extrude a Cut (remove material)

specs.name: solidworks_extrude_midplane
specs.doc: Extrude a sketch symmetrically about its plane. ⚠ The parameter is the TOTAL depth, not the per-side depth.
specs.title: Extrude Symmetrically About the Sketch Plane

specs.name: solidworks_chamfer
specs.doc: Chamfer the selected edge(s). ★ The edge comes from `selection` (declarative), because the API takes no edge object — it acts on the current selection.
specs.title: Chamfer the Selected Edge(s)

specs.name: solidworks_fillet
specs.doc: Round the selected edge(s) with the given radius. ★ The edge comes from `selection` (declarative) — the capability layer passes edges=None, i.e. it acts on the current selection.
specs.title: Round (Fillet) the Selected Edge(s)

specs.name: solidworks_part_mass_properties
specs.doc: Read the mass properties of the ACTIVE part, without any conversion: volume (mm^3), surface area (mm^2), centre of mass (mm, three components) and density. ★★ IMPORTANT: the API is measured to return MILLIMETRE-based values (a 40x20x10 mm box reports volume 8000 and surface area 2800), NOT SI metres — so nothing here is scaled. ⚠★ `mass` is passed through as reported, but ITS PHYSICAL UNIT IS NOT VERIFIED: on the test box its value equals volume(mm^3) x density, which does not form a consistent unit with either mm^3 or m^3 — treat the number as unverified rather than assume a unit. ⚠ `AccuracyLevel` is not exposed (the member is not readable on this build). ★ Reading only; writing overrides is a different capability.
specs.title: Read Part Mass Properties

specs.name: solidworks_assembly_list_components
specs.doc: List the components of the ACTIVE assembly: for each one its name, file path, whether it is suppressed and whether it is visible. ★ Reading only.
specs.title: List Assembly Components

specs.name: solidworks_assembly_list_mates
specs.doc: List the MateGroup and mate features of the active assembly (name, type, tree depth). ★ Use it to check that real mates were actually written into the feature tree — it does NOT report degrees of freedom.
specs.title: List Assembly Mates

specs.name: solidworks_assembly_check_interference
specs.doc: Run interference detection on the ACTIVE assembly and return an auditable report: `status` (pass when nothing interferes / warn when something does / blocked when the check itself failed), `interference_count`, and per-interference `volume` + `component_count`. ⚠ `blocked` means the CHECK failed — do not read it as 'no interference'. ★ Reading only (it runs the detector, it does not change the model).
specs.title: Check Assembly Interference

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_fixed_restraint
specs.doc: Apply a FIXED restraint (fixture) to the selected face(s) of a static study and return the ICWRestraint. ★ The faces come from `selection` (declarative) because the capability layer assembles them into the official DispArray. ⚠ Requires the Simulation add-in; the first call loads it automatically.
specs.title: Apply a Fixed Restraint (Fixture) to the Selected Faces

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_normal_force
specs.doc: Apply a NORMAL force to the selected face(s) of a static study and return the ICWForce. ★ The faces come from `selection` (declarative). ⚠ The magnitude is in NEWTONS — it is not converted.
specs.title: Apply a Normal Force to the Selected Faces

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_create_study
specs.doc: Create a STATIC simulation study and return a JSON-able report: `{ok, requested_name, study_name, entry_name, error_code}`. ★★ Read `entry_name`: it names the entry point that actually succeeded (CreateNewStudy3 / 2 / 1), so an EMPTY value means the study was NOT created — this is the only evidence of whether a fallback path was used. ⚠ Only static studies are supported (other study types are not verified). ⚠ Requires the Simulation add-in; it is loaded automatically on first use.
specs.title: Create a Static Simulation Study

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_list_studies
specs.doc: List every simulation study in the active document as `[{index, name}, …]`. ★ Returns names only, never COM objects. ★ A study whose name cannot be read is still listed with an empty name — it is not skipped, so an empty list really means 'no studies'.
specs.title: List Simulation Studies

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_find_study
specs.doc: Look up a simulation study by name and return `{found, requested_name, study_name}`. ★★ The capability layer returns None when the name does not exist (it does not raise), so this tool exposes an explicit `found` flag instead — never read a missing study as present.
specs.title: Find a Simulation Study by Name

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_mesh_size
specs.doc: Return the suggested mesh `{element_size, tolerance, units}` for a study. ★ The default units = -1 yields MILLIMETRE-scale values (verified in this repo) and nothing is converted — the `units` value is echoed back so the caller can tell.
specs.title: Get the Suggested Mesh Element Size

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_create_mesh
specs.doc: Mesh the study and return a READ-BACK report `{ok, return_code, return_is_trustworthy, element_count}`. ★★ Judge success by `ok`, which is derived from `element_count > 0` — NOT from the return code (this repo's rule: COM return values that cannot prove themselves are never trusted; `return_is_trustworthy` is always false).
specs.title: Create the Mesh for a Study

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_run_analysis
specs.doc: Run the study and return a READ-BACK report `{ok, return_code, return_is_trustworthy, results_present, plot_count, plot_names}`. ★★ Judge success by `ok` (= results present AND plot_count > 0), NOT by the return code — this repo has documented four separate cases of a COM return code lying.
specs.title: Run the Study and Report Read-Back Results

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_collect_evidence
specs.doc: Return a JSON-able summary of every study in the active document: per-study `name / type / state / entity_count / analysis_type / mesh_type / configuration / is_active / loads_and_restraints`, plus `cosmos_version`, `study_count` and `active_study_index`. ★ Reading only.
specs.title: Collect Simulation Study Evidence

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_pressure
specs.doc: Apply a PRESSURE load to the selected face(s) of a static study and return a READ-BACK report (`count_before` / `count_after`), not a COM object. ★ `ok` means the load/restraint count went up by exactly one — the criterion is read-back, never the return value. ⚠ Requires the Simulation add-in; the first call loads it automatically.
specs.title: Apply a Pressure Load to the Selected Faces

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_torque
specs.doc: Apply a TORQUE load (`AddForce` with swsForceTypeTorque) to the selected face(s) of a static study and return a READ-BACK report (`count_before` / `count_after`). ★ The result is judged by read-back, not by a return object. ⚠ Requires the Simulation add-in.
specs.title: Apply a Torque Load to the Selected Faces

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_gravity
specs.doc: Apply a GRAVITY load to the selected entity of a static study and return a READ-BACK report. ⚠ The official parameter is a SINGLE entity (DispEntity), so only the FIRST entity of the selection is used. ★ Judged by read-back, not by a return object.
specs.title: Apply a Gravity Load to the Selected Entity

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_centrifugal_force
specs.doc: Apply a CENTRIFUGAL FORCE to the selected entity of a static study and return a READ-BACK report. ⚠ The official parameter is a SINGLE entity, so only the FIRST entity of the selection is used. ★ Judged by read-back, not by a return object.
specs.title: Apply a Centrifugal Force to the Selected Entity

specs.name: solidworks_topology_collect_numbers
specs.doc: Read the topology study's numbers as a JSON-able dict: results presence, plot count, plot names, max available steps, and ★ `material_mass_plot` — the CORE criterion of this capability (the material-mass plot appearing in GetPlotNames). ★ Read-only.
specs.title: Read Topology Study Numbers (Results, Plots, Material-Mass Plot)

specs.name: solidworks_topology_list_constraints
specs.doc: Report which constraints and controls already exist on the topology study as BOOLEANS plus a count (never COM objects). ⚠ This is the READ-BACK the set_* tools use — a kind is `true` only when it was actually retrieved. ★ Read-only.
specs.title: List Which Topology Constraints/Controls Already Exist

specs.name: solidworks_topology_manager_report
specs.doc: Return a JSON-able report about the topology study manager: whether it exists, its object type, and which constraint/control kinds are retrievable. ★ The COM object itself is never returned.
specs.title: Read the Topology Study Manager (as a JSON report)

specs.name: solidworks_topology_options_report
specs.doc: Return a JSON-able report about the topology study options: whether the options object exists and its type. ★ The COM object itself is never returned.
specs.title: Read the Topology Study Options (as a JSON report)

specs.name: solidworks_topology_set_goal
specs.doc: Set the topology study goal and return a READ-BACK report comparing the number of retrievable constraints/controls before and after. ★ `ok` means no exception AND the count did not decrease — never the return object. ⚠ Sets parameters only; it does NOT run the solver.
specs.title: Set the Topology Study Goal (read-back confirmed)

specs.name: solidworks_topology_set_iteration_options
specs.doc: Set the topology iteration options and return a READ-BACK report comparing the retrievable constraint/control count before and after. ★ `ok` means no exception AND the count did not decrease. ⚠ Sets parameters only; it does NOT run the solver. ⚠⚠ The option VALUES are intentionally NOT exposed: their enums (swsTopologyIterationOption_e and the count's valid range) are not verified in this repo — the capability layer itself says to look them up in the reflection dump. ★ Exposing an invented sentinel would be worse than not exposing the argument, so the tool only carries `study_name` and reproduces the capability layer's own defaults.

specs.title: Create Loft Feature

specs.name: solidworks_part_sweep
specs.doc: ★ **用选中的「轮廓 + 路径」建扫描特征** —— 走官方**现代入口** `IFeatureManager.CreateDefinition(swFmSweep=17)` → `ISweepFeatureData` → `CreateFeature`（★ `InsertProtrusionSwept*` 整族已被 SOLIDWORKS 2018 标为 **obsolete**）。★ 官方专文给的 mark：**轮廓 = 1** · **路径 = 4** · 引导线 = 2 · 方向向量 = 128。⚠ 官方硬约束：**路径的起点必须落在轮廓所在平面上**（1 方向扫描）—— 真机上违反它就会建不成。★★ 判据（事实 242：挑只依赖被测对象的那个）：**特征树多了新特征** **且** **类型名 = `Sweep`**。★ 真机证据：建成 `扫描1`（type=`Sweep`）· 未选中 ⇒ 显式拒绝。⚠ `AccessSelections` 在本机报 `0x80010105`（事实 47 的后端限制）——★ 而**它非必需**：真机上它报错时特征仍建成，所以本工具**不拿它当判据**。
specs.title: Create Sweep Feature

specs.name: solidworks_part_axis
specs.doc: ★ **从当前选中的几何建一条参考轴** —— 走 `IModelDoc2.InsertAxis2`（★ **注意入口在 `IModelDoc2` 上**，不在 `IFeatureManager` 上；★ 真机调后者报`AttributeError: <unknown>.InsertAxis2`）。★ 官方要求**先选中**几何（★ 圆柱面 / 圆锥面 / 两点等 —— ★ 面没有名字，按**面上的对象**选，事实 32）。★★ 判据（★ 事实 242 挑只依赖被测对象的那个）：**它回 `True`** **且** **特征树出现新特征**（★ 真机：`基准轴1`）—— ⚠ **不要读返回值的 `.Name`**：真机证明它回的是 **`bool`**，读 `.Name` 会报 `'bool' object has no attribute 'Name'`（★ 差点据此误判「轴没建成」）。★ 环形阵列的前置：官方 `FeatureCircularPattern4` 的 mark 表要求 `1 = 方向轴`。
specs.title: Create Reference Axis

specs.name: solidworks_part_wrap
specs.doc: ★ **对已选中的「草图（mark=4）+ 面（mark=1）」建包覆特征** —— 走官方 `IFeatureManager.InsertWrapFeature2`（**5 参**）。★ 官方要求：★ **草图 mark = 4**（★ 且**必须是 2D 草图**，官方原话 「3D sketches are invalid」）· ★ **面 mark = 1** · ★ 拔模方向 mark = 2（仅 Emboss/Engrave 用）。★★ 判据 = **读返回对象的 `Name` 与 `GetTypeName2`** —— ★ 真机：返回 `包覆1` · 类型名 **`Emboss`**；⚠ 而 `feature_names()` 的**前后 diff 是空的**（★ 所以「树 diff」不是可靠判据）。⚠ **未验**：`Type` 传非 emboss 时**类型名不变**（★ 参数被静默忽略）· `Method` / `MeshFactor`（第 4/5 参）**取值表没查到**（用 0）。
specs.title: Create Wrap Feature

specs.name: solidworks_read_sensors
specs.doc: ★ **列出文档里的传感器并读它们当前的值** —— 走 `ISensor`（10 个成员）。★ 官方入口现状：★ **能读不能建**（反射里没有 `AddXxxSensor`）· ★ **也没有「列出所有传感器」的成员** ⇒ ★ 本工具走**特征树遍历 + `GetSpecificFeature2()`**。★ `GetSensorValue(out double Value, out string Units)` 的官方签名是 **0 参 + 2 个 out**（★ 反射里 `'GetSensorValue': 0` 那行才是 arity）。★ 判据：**函数跑到尾且结构完整** —— ★ 空文档回 `count=0` 且不炸是对的。★ 真机证据（PASS 3/3）：空零件 / 有几何的零件 / 带外部参考的示例图，三处 `ok=True` · `count=0` · `errors=[]`。⚠ **未真机验证**：**非空路径**（★ 那三个文档都没有传感器，而官方**不能建** —— 要造非空场景只能手工在 UI 里建）· 以及 `Units` 那个 out 参数的实际取值。
specs.title: Read Sensors

specs.name: solidworks_undo
specs.doc: ★ **撤销** —— 走 `IModelDoc2.EditUndo2`（官方 **1 参** · ★★ **返回 `void`**）。★★ 判据（规则 6）：**特征树真的退回了**（真机：7 → 6 · 撤掉 `凸台-拉伸1`）。★ 负例 `steps = 0` ⇒ 显式拒绝。⚠ **调用纪律**：★ 它撤的是**会话里的动作**、**不区分是不是我们做的** ⇒ ★ **只在我们自己的改动之后调用**（★ 例如「建完发现参数错 ⇒ 撕掉重来」）。
specs.title: Undo Actions

specs.name: solidworks_read_document_units
specs.doc: ★ **读文档单位**（★ 两条路：主源 + 对照源，★ 它们是**不同层次**、**允许不同**）。★ 主源 `IModelDoc2.GetUnits()`（**0 参**）—— 官方 Remarks 原话：返回 **5 个 short 的数组** `[LengthUnit, FractionBase, FractionValue, SignificantDigits, RoundToFraction]`，`LengthUnit` 取 `swLengthUnit_e`（`swMM = 0`）。★ 对照源 `ISldWorks.GetUserPreferenceIntegerValue(swUnitsLinear = 47)` —— ★ **1 参**（★ 三源一致：官方签名 / 反射 / 官方示例），★ 它是**系统默认**（★ 新建文档的默认），**不是**文档级。★★ 判据：**`LengthUnit` 应为 0（`swMM`）** —— ★ 因为本仓库**建模一律按毫米**；★ 不是 0 就说明该文档单位不是毫米，★ 而那时「我们的 mm 参数」与文档单位之间存在**未声明的换算**。★ 真机证据（PASS 4/4）：`GetUnits()` ⇒ `(0, 1, 8, 2, 0)` ⇒ `LengthUnit = 0` = `swMM` · `is_mm = true`；系统默认也 = 0；`doc_matches_system_default = true`。⚠ **未真机验证**：`SetUnits`（★ 5 参，★ 本工具只读不写）· 非毫米文档下的读数（★ 本机文档都是毫米）。
specs.title: Read Document Units

specs.name: solidworks_selection_count
specs.doc: ★ **回读当前选区计数**（`ISelectionMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)`）。★★ 它是**选择类判据的唯一来源** —— 事实 8：`SelectByID2` / `Select4` 的 bool 返回值不可信（实测 12 次全 false 而计数 = 12）⇒ ★ **判「选没选中」永远看本工具的回读数**。
specs.title: Selection Count

specs.name: solidworks_select_entity_by_index
specs.doc: ★ **按序号选中体上的一个实体**（`kind` = `EDGE` / `FACE` / `VERTEX`，`index` 从 0 起）。★ 走 `IEntity.Select4`（★ 事实 32：对边/面**按名字选不中**，按**对象**选才行）。★ 返回**回读到的选区计数**。⚠ 序号顺序官方**未承诺稳定**（★ 见 `entities_on_body`）⇒ 不要把它当跨重建的持久引用。
specs.title: Select Entity By Index

specs.name: solidworks_resolve_selection
specs.doc: ★ **把声明式选择器解析并选中**，只回报**回读到的选区计数**。★ 选择器：`__current_selection__`（用当前选区第一个，**不重选**）· `index:<n>`（体上第 n 个）。★ 计数为 0 时**抛错**（★ 本项目一贯纪律：选不中就报错，不静默继续）。
specs.title: Resolve Selection (count)

specs.name: solidworks_selection_point
specs.doc: ★ **读当前选区那个点的坐标**（★ **毫米**，规则 2）。★★ 用途：★ 孔族吃 `center`（一个坐标元组）⇒ 包一层「**先选点、再建孔**」⇒ ★ **工具层的参数里就没有坐标了**（★ 规则 3 的精神）。★ 回 `{ok, point_mm, selection_count, error}`；⚠ **不猜**：★ `GetSelectionPoint` 取不到就 `ok=False` 并写明原因（★ 铁律 5）。
specs.title: Selection Point (mm)

specs.name: solidworks_select_by_selector
specs.doc: ★ **用声明式选择器选中一个实体** —— ★ MCP 可用的形态（★ 只回 JSON，**不回 COM 对象**）。★ 它把 `select_object`（吃 COM 对象）与 `resolve_entity`（吐 COM 对象）**接起来**。★★ 判据是 `count`（★ 事实 8：`Select4` 的返回值不可信，只有回读算数）；★ 计数为 0 时 `ok=False` **并写明原因**。
specs.title: Select By Selector

specs.name: solidworks_resolve_entity
specs.doc: ★ **解析声明式选择器并回报结果**（★ 只回 JSON —— 把 COM 对象挡在里面）。★ `resolve_entity` 本身**返回 COM 对象** ⇒ MCP 层过不去 ⇒ 本工具换成可核对的描述。★ 回 `{ok, selector, kind, count, resolved}`：★ `resolved` = 解析出了对象；★★ 而**是否真的在选区里**看 `count`（★ **解析出来 ≠ 选中**）；★ 而 `__current_selection__` 是**不重选**的 ⇒ 那种情况下 `resolved=True` 而 `count=0` 是正常的。
specs.title: Resolve Entity (report)

specs.name: solidworks_current_sketch_name
specs.doc: ★ **读当前活动草图的特征名**。⚠ 它**在草图已关闭时**会回 `fallback`（★ 默认 `Sketch1`）—— ★ 那**不是**真名（中文 UI 是「草图1」）。★★ 所以：**要按名字去取草图对象时，不要用本工具的返回值** —— ★ 用 `scripts/sw_sketch.resolve_sketch`（中英文候选 + 特征树兜底，语言无关）。
specs.title: Current Sketch Name

specs.name: solidworks_auto_dimension_sketch
specs.doc: ★ **按官方 `ISketch.AutoDimension2` 流程给当前草图建真实模型尺寸** ——★ 生成的尺寸是**真实的 `DisplayDimension`**（★ 可被工程图导入并复核），★ 不是草图里画几条线。★ 回 `{status, status_code, error_code, selected}`：★ `status` = `pass` / `blocked` / `failed`；★★ `blocked` + `SKETCH_NOT_ACTIVE` = **没有活动草图**（★ 先 `solidworks_sketch_start`）。
specs.title: Auto-Dimension the Sketch

specs.name: solidworks_add_dimension
specs.doc: ★ **给已选中的实体加一个显示尺寸**（官方 `IModelDoc2.AddDimension2`，**3 参**）。★★ **单位**：官方原话是 “Dimension text location in **meters**” ⇒ ★ 本工具对外收**毫米**并在此换算。★★ **前置**：官方 Remarks 明写「Before calling this method, you must **select the entities**」⇒ ★ 本工具**先用声明式选择器选中**（★ 选不中就**不开工**并说明原因）。★ 真机证据：纯盒体上 **8/8 个边对**都建出了尺寸（`output/dimension-edge-pairs-evidence.json`）。⚠★ **已知限制（未隔离）**：同一个包装在**板 + 凸台**的模型上失败 —— ★ 连试 3 次后按事实 53 停止隔离；★ 官方另注「**only use on visible documents**」且尺寸**按位置**放置（★ 位置不落在可见模型上时可能建不出来）。
specs.title: Add a Display Dimension

specs.name: solidworks_hole_pattern
specs.doc: ★ **按显式孔位一次创建一组孔**（★ 官方走 `HoleWizard5` 那族）。★★ 它把 `create_hole_pattern` 的 **`creator` 可调用对象**换成**具名的 `kind`** ——★ 因为 MCP 层给不出函数对象。★★ 判据**两条都要**：★ 每个孔位都回了证据 **且** **特征树真的长了**（★ 规则 6）——★ 只回证据而树不动 ⇒ `ok=false` 并写明（★ 本会话已见过「回对象而什么都没发生」的空存根）。⚠ 本工具只支持 `through` / `blind`：★ `counterbore` / `countersink` 另有必填参数，未暴露。
specs.title: Create Holes at Explicit Positions

specs.name: solidworks_export_image
specs.doc: ★ **把当前视图存成图片**（PNG / JPG，走官方 `IModelDocExtension.SaveAs3`）。★★ 判据**不是返回值**而是**文件**：`ok = 无异常 且 文件存在 且 size > 0`。★ 另回 `size_before` / `grew_or_created` —— ★ 免得把「旧文件本来就在」当成导出成功。★ 真机证据：一张 PNG ⇒ `exists=true` · `size_bytes=67997` · `grew_or_created=true`。⚠ 尺寸**不可指定**（`SaveAs3` 没有尺寸入参）⇒ ★ 按**当前视图**。（★ 要指定像素尺寸请用 `solidworks_export_bmp`。）
specs.title: Export the Current View as an Image

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_rigid_connector
specs.doc: Add a **RIGID CONNECTOR** between two bodies and return a READ-BACK report. ★★ **本工具不读选区** —— 它自己按**序号**把两组实体装好（`entities_as_array`）。⚠★ **它要在「两个体」上才建得出来**：★ 在**单体零件**上会**成功返回但不建**（计数不涨、也不报错）—— ★ 那是**应然的**（同族形参名写着 `Comp1`/`Comp2` ⇒ **连接件连的是两个东西**）。★ 所以请**两侧体号指向不同的体**（多体零件即用；装配体属另一条链）。★ `ok` 的判据是**回读**：载荷计数**恰好 +1**，★ **不是**返回值。
specs.title: Apply a Rigid Connector

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_create_structural_member
specs.doc: Create a **STRUCTURAL MEMBER** (weldment) along a path sketch with a weldment profile, and return a READ-BACK report. ★★ **判据是特征树**（★ 不是计数）：`new_type_names` 应含 `WeldmentFeature` 与 `WeldMemberFeat`。⚠ 本机需要装「焊件轮廓库」—— ★ 本机**有**（111 个 `.sldlfp`）。
specs.title: Create a Structural Member

specs.name: solidworks_select_face_selector
specs.doc: Select ONE face by a **declarative selector** and return a READ-BACK report. ★★ 这是「**按面上的点定位**」那条路（★ 事实 32：`SelectByID2` 对边/面**按名字不可行**，而**按点可行**）—— ★ 而本工具把它包成**声明式**（★ 规则 3）。★ `ok` 的判据是**回读计数 == 1**（★ **不是**返回值 —— 事实 8）。★★ **不接受裸坐标**：★ 坐标在能力层内部算，★ 对外的参数**只有选择器**。
specs.title: Select a Face by Declarative Selector

specs.name: solidworks_simulation_apply_link_connector
specs.doc: Add a **LINK CONNECTOR** between two **vertices** and return a READ-BACK report. ★★ **它要的是「顶点」** —— ★ 官方形参名就是 `VertexPointforFirst/SecondLocation`。⚠★ **不要传面 / 组件**（★ 那一族是 `AddRigidConnector` 收面、`AddPinConnector` 收组件）——★ 传错会**静默不建**（★ 事实 341 那五次就是这么来的）。★ `ok` 的判据是**回读**：载荷与约束计数 **恰好 +1**（★ **不是**返回值 —— 事实 8）。
specs.title: Apply a Link Connector (between two vertices)

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_trim
specs.doc: Trim the selected sketch entities. ⚠ How many segments must be selected DEPENDS on the option (official Remarks: closest = exactly one, corner = exactly two).
specs.title: Trim Sketch Entities

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_extend
specs.doc: Extend the selected sketch entity to the nearest entity.
specs.title: Extend a Sketch Entity

specs.doc: Offset the selected sketch entities (official swSkOffsetCapEndType_e / swSkOffsetMakeConstructionType_e values are used verbatim).
specs.title: Offset Sketch Entities (offset entities)

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_fillet
specs.doc: Create a SKETCH fillet on two selected, intersecting sketch segments.
specs.title: Draw a Sketch Fillet

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_linear_pattern
specs.doc: Create a LINEAR sketch pattern of the selected entities (official 12-arg call).
specs.title: Linear Sketch Pattern

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_circular_pattern
specs.doc: Create a CIRCULAR sketch pattern of the selected entities (official 9-arg call).
specs.title: Circular Sketch Pattern

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_move_entities
specs.doc: ★ 移动实体：`IModelDoc2.SketchModifyTranslate`（★ 改的是**草图坐标系**）。★ 判据 = `ModelToSketchTransform.ArrayData` 的平移分量变化（★ 真机 5mm 严格对应）。
specs.title: Move Sketch Entities

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_rotate_entities
specs.doc: ★ 旋转实体：`IModelDoc2.SketchModifyRotate`（★ 改的是**草图坐标系**）。★ 真机验证：30° ⇒ 3×3 旋转矩阵首行变成 `[0.866025, -0.500001, 0]`（cos30°/sin30°）。
specs.title: Rotate Sketch Entities

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_scale_entities
specs.doc: ★ 缩放实体比例：`IModelDoc2.SketchModifyScale` —— ★ **本批唯一有 bool 返回值**的成员。★ 真机验证：1.5 ⇒ 草图 bbox 从 ±20/±10 变成 ±30/±15（**正好 ×1.5**）。
specs.title: Scale Sketch Entities

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_stretch_entities
specs.doc: ★ 伸展实体：**`IModelDocExtension.Stretch`**（★ 入口在 **Extension** 上，不是 `IModelDoc2`）。⚠ 官方说明「Stretch the **selected** entities」⇒ ★ **要求先选中实体**。
specs.title: Stretch Sketch Entities

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_flip_entities
specs.doc: ★ 镜像/翻转：`IModelDoc2.SketchModifyFlip(AxisFlag)`。★ 真机验证：`axis_flag=1` ⇒ 3×3 旋转矩阵首行从 `[1,0,0]` 变成 **`[-1,0,0]`**（X 符号翻转）。⚠ `AxisFlag` 的取值表**官方未给** ⇒ 按铁律 5 原样透传、不猜语义。
specs.title: Flip Sketch Entities

specs.name: solidworks_insert_planar_surface
specs.doc: ★ 平面区域：`IModelDoc2.InsertPlanarRefSurface()`（**零参数**，回 `bool`）。★ 官方语义：用**当前选中的封闭边界**（草图 / 边）生成一张平面曲面 ⇒ ★ **调用前要选好边界**。★ 真机：树 6→7，新增 `曲面-基准面1`。
specs.title: Insert Planar Surface

specs.name: solidworks_insert_offset_surface
specs.doc: ★ 等距曲面：`IModelDoc2.InsertOffsetSurface(Thickness, Reverse)`（回 `void`）。★ 真机：树 7→8，新增 `曲面-等距1`。⚠ 官方回 `void` ⇒ 判据只能是**特征树增量**。
specs.title: Insert Offset Surface

specs.name: solidworks_insert_ruled_surface
specs.doc: ★ 直纹曲面：`IFeatureManager.InsertRuledSurfaceFromEdge2(…)`（**11 参**，回 `Feature`）。⚠ 官方 Remarks 逐字：「If you select an edge with a **selection mark of 4**, the default face is used.」⇒ ★ **调用前先把边按 `mark=4` 选中**。★ 真机：树 7→8，新增 `直纹曲面1`。★ 用的是 `…FromEdge2`（★ `…FromEdge` 官方标 **Obsolete**，铁律 4）。
specs.title: Insert Ruled Surface

specs.name: solidworks_insert_delete_face
specs.doc: ★ 删除面：**`IModelDocExtension.InsertDeleteFace(Option)`**（回 `bool`）。⚠ ★ 入口在 **Extension** 上；★ `IModelDoc2.InsertDeleteFace2` 官方标 **Obsolete**（铁律 4）⇒ 用后继版。★ 真机（`option=0`）：树 7→8，新增 `删除面1`。⚠ 官方 Returns 逐字：True 表示**插入了 DeleteFace 特征**。
specs.title: Insert Delete Face

specs.name: solidworks_insert_replace_face
specs.doc: ★ 替换面：`IModelDoc2.InsertFeatureReplaceFace()`（**零参数**，回 `void`）。⚠ 官方 Remarks 逐字：调用前要**选中面** —— 要被替换的面 **mark=1**、替换面 **mark=2**。★ 真机：树 7→8，新增 `替换面1`（★ 而前置要用**实体**的面，不是曲面体的面）。
specs.title: Insert Replace Face

specs.name: solidworks_insert_lofted_ref_surface
specs.doc: ★ 放样曲面：`IModelDoc2.InsertLoftRefSurface2(…)`（6 参，回 `void`）。⚠ 官方 Remarks 逐字：「The mark for: **profile selections should be 1**」⇒ ★ **调用前把轮廓按 `mark=1` 选好**（★ 且**按期望的顺序**）。★ 真机建成：树 7→8，新增 `曲面-放样1`。★ 用的是 `…RefSurface2`（★ `…RefSurface` 官方标 **Obsolete**，铁律 4）。
specs.title: Insert Lofted Reference Surface

specs.name: solidworks_insert_center_of_mass
specs.doc: ★ 质心：`IFeatureManager.InsertCenterOfMass()`（**零参数**，回 `Feature`）。★ 真机建成（★ 判据 = 回对象非 None + 特征树增量）。
specs.title: Insert Center of Mass

specs.name: solidworks_insert_global_bounding_box
specs.doc: ★ 边界框：`IFeatureManager.InsertGlobalBoundingBox2(…)`（5 参，回 `IFeature`）。★★ **台账 T701 给的 `Create3DBoundingBox` 是焊件切割清单专用的另一个** ——官方的才是这条。★ 第 5 个形参 `Status` 是 **out**（`swGlobalBoundingBoxResult_e`，**Success=0**）⇒ 实现层用 `sw_connect.out_i4()` 包（★ 裸传 int 会 `类型不匹配`，位置 5）。★ 真机建成：**`Status=0 (Success)`** + 特征树增量。
specs.title: Insert Global Bounding Box

specs.name: solidworks_insert_coordinate_system
specs.doc: ★ 坐标系：`IFeatureManager.InsertCoordinateSystem(…)`（3 参，回 `Feature`）。★ 用的是 `IFeatureManager` 那个 —— `IModelDoc2.InsertCoordinateSystem` 官方标 **Obsolete**（铁律 4），★ 且新版回 `Feature`、旧版回 `bool`。★ 真机建成。
specs.title: Insert Coordinate System

specs.name: solidworks_insert_ref_plane
specs.doc: ★ 基准面：`IFeatureManager.InsertRefPlane`（6 参，回 [[Reference plane]]）。⚠⚠ **调用前必须按 mark 选参考实体** —— 官方 Remarks 逐字给了表：**0 = First reference entity · 1 = Second · 2 = Third**。★ 真机：选一个面（**mark=0**）+ `Coincident(4)` ⇒ 树新增 `基准面1`。
specs.title: Insert Reference Plane

specs.name: solidworks_insert_reference_point
specs.doc: ★ 点：`IFeatureManager.InsertReferencePoint`（4 参，回 [[IFeature]]）。⚠ 官方 Remarks：`NumberOfRefPoints` **必须是 1**。★ 真机：先选一个面（**mark=0**）+ `FaceCenter(4)` ⇒ 树新增 `点1`。★★ 而选面**必须紧接着调用** —— 中间隔别的步骤会把选区清掉。
specs.title: Insert Reference Point

specs.name: solidworks_insert_curve_through_points
specs.doc: ★ 通过参考点的曲线：`InsertCurveFileBegin()` → `InsertCurveFilePoint(X,Y,Z)`×N → `InsertCurveFileEnd()`（★ **三步式**，★ 别只调中间那个）。★ 真机建成：树新增 `曲线1`（★ 顺带验证了「按米换算」这个假设是对的）。★ 判据 = `Point`/`End` 的返回值 **且** 特征树增量。
specs.title: Insert Curve Through Points

specs.name: solidworks_create_revolved_surface
specs.doc: ★ **旋转曲面**：`IFeatureManager.InsertRevolvedRefSurface(…)` → `IFeature`。★ 官方逐字「Creates a revolved reference surface by revolving a profile around a centerline.」——与实体版 `revolve_boss` 同形，★ 只是产出**曲面**。⚠ **调用前要选好轮廓**（官方 Remarks 逐字：Make the selections using `IModelDocExtension::SelectByID2` before calling）；★ 官方**没给 mark** ⇒ 本工具不假定 mark。★ 官方另注「does not support **3D sketches**」。★ 真机建成：树新增 `曲面-旋转1` · 曲面体 0→1。
specs.title: Create Revolved Surface

specs.name: solidworks_hole_wizard
specs.doc: ★ **孔向导 / 异型孔**：`IFeatureManager.HoleWizard5`（★ 官方 24+ 参，本工具已把前置配好）。★ 判据 = **特征树增量**（★ 真机新增 `异型孔向导`）。★ 三个前置缺一不可（已知事实 483）：① 孔位用 `SelectByRay`（`Mark=0`）选出来；② `SSize` 要**规格串**；③ `FastenerTypeIndex` 要与 standard 匹配。
specs.title: Hole Wizard (Advanced Hole)

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_fully_defined_status
specs.doc: ★ **草图完全定义状态**：`ISketch.GetConstrainedStatus()` → `System.int`（官方零参数、只读）。⚠ **前置**：**必须有一个正在编辑的草图**（关掉的草图取不到 `ISketch`）⇒ 没有就**抛**，不静默。★ 真机：欠定义矩形回 **2**、对 4 段加 `sgFIXED` 后回 **3** ⇒ 读数**有区分度**。⚠ **官方没给取值表** ⇒ 本工具**如实回原始 int**，★ **不把它解释成「欠定义/完全定义」**（★ 铁律 5：查不到就说查不到）。
specs.title: Sketch Fully-Defined Status

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_broken_view
specs.doc: ★ **断裂视图**：`IView.InsertBreak3(6 参)` → `BreakLine`。★★ `InsertBreak`（4 参）与 `InsertBreak2`（5 参）**官方都标 Obsolete** ⇒ ★ 只走 3。★ 官方 `## Remarks`：Horizontal ⇒ 位置是 **Y** 值；Vertical ⇒ **X** 值；★ 都相对视图原点。★ **判据 = `GetBreakLines()` 的数组长度 + `IView.IsBroken()`**（★ 两个都要）——★ 官方把这两件事**定义成了两件**：有断裂线**不等于**断开了。⚠ 官方**没给位置参数的单位** ⇒ 本工具按米收、按毫米传、只在边界换算一次。
specs.title: Drawing Break Lines (Broken View)

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_auxiliary_view
specs.doc: ★ **辅助视图**：`IDrawingDoc.CreateAuxiliaryViewAt2(7 参)`。★★★ **官方前置（摘要逐字）**：「Creates an auxiliary view **based on a selected edge in a drawing view**」⇒ ★★ **调用前必须先选中视图里的一条边**。★ 而**边没有可用的名字**（本仓事实 32）⇒ ★ 本工具**不代选**，★ 只**回读当前选区计数**并写进 `preconditions_held` ⇒ 失败时能看见原因。★ **判据 = 视图数增量 + 新视图 `Type == 5`（`swDrawingAuxiliaryView`）**，★ 不是「返回非 None」。⚠ `NotAligned` 的官方说明与形参名矛盾，见该参数说明。
specs.title: Drawing Auxiliary View

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_insert_surface_finish_symbol
specs.doc: ★ **表面粗糙度符号**：`IModelDocExtension.InsertSurfaceFinishSymbol3(14 参)`。★★ **官方 `## Remarks` 逐字**：「The SOLIDWORKS Design software uses the location parameters for this method **only if** the surface finish symbol has a leader leaderType **!= swNO_LEADER**.」⇒ ★★ `leader_type = 0` 时**三个位置参数被官方无视**⇒ ★ 本工具在那一档**主动传 0** 并把原坐标回在 `ignored_location_mm`。★ **另一条前置**：官方摘要逐字「based on the **last selection**」⇒ ★ 调用前必须有选区；★ 本工具**不代选**（★ 规则 3 禁裸坐标），只回读选区计数写进 `preconditions_held`。★ **判据 = 全图纸 `IView.GetSFSymbolCount` 求和的增量**，★ 不是「返回非 None」。
specs.title: Drawing Surface Finish Symbol

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_insert_datum_tag
specs.doc: ★ **基准符号**：`IModelDoc2.InsertDatumTag2()` → `DatumTag`（★ **官方零参数**）。★★ **官方前置**（摘要逐字）：「Inserts a datum tag symbol **at a selected location**.」⇒ ★ 调用前必须先选中一个位置（★ 官方示例用 `SelectByID2` 选 EDGE）。★ 因为官方**零参数**，★ 落点**完全由选区决定** ⇒ 本工具**没有坐标入口**（★ 这既由官方签名决定，★ 也正好合上规则 3 的「禁裸坐标」）。★ 入口是 `IModelDoc2`（**不是** `IModelDocExtension`）—— ★ 与表面粗糙度符号那 14 参**不是同一个宿主对象**。★ **判据 = 全图纸 `IView.GetDatumTagCount` 求和的增量**，★ 不是「返回非 None」。
specs.title: Drawing Datum Tag

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_insert_miter_flange
specs.doc: ★ **钣金斜接法兰**：`IFeatureManager.InsertSheetMetalMiterFlange(14 参)` → `Feature`。★★★ **同名两份页、★ 参数个数不同**：★ `IModelDoc2` 那份（11 参 · 回 void）官方逐字标 `Obsolete. Superseded by [[IFeatureManager::InsertSheetMetalMiterFlange]].` ⇒ ★ **本工具走 IFeatureManager 那份**，★ 而用错的后果是**参数个数对不上**、★ 不只是「没反应」。⚠ 末位 `PCBA` 是**对象形参**：★ 官方把它写成二选一 —— **non-NULL** ⇒ "Pointer to `ICustomBendAllowance` object **for which required values have been set**"；**NULL** ⇒ "Parent bend's bend allowance is used" ⇒ ★ 本工具传**空 Dispatch**（＝ NULL 语义）★★ **不伪造一个没设过必需值的 PCBA**，★ 因此**不接受自定义 PCBA**。★★ **前置查不到**：★ 该官方页**无 `## Remarks` 段**（逐字段核过）⇒ ★ 本工具**不编前置**（铁律 5），★ 只回读选区计数、★ `preconditions_held` 如实报 **None**（★ 不是 False）。★ 判据 = **特征树增量** + 返回对象非 None + **实体面数增量**（三个都要）。
specs.title: Sheet Metal Miter Flange

specs.name: solidworks_sheet_metal_insert_closed_corner
specs.doc: ★ **钣金闭合角**：`IModelDoc2.InsertSheetMetalClosedCorner()` → **`void`**（★ **零参**）。⚠⚠★ **这是本批判据最紧的一条**，★ 因为官方**同时**给了「零参数」与「回 `void`」：⇒ ★ **没有返回对象可读** ⇒ ★「返回非 None」这条判据在本工具上**根本不存在** ⇒ ★ 判据**只能**是 **特征树增量** + **实体面数增量** + **体积增量**（★ 后两个互相独立、缺一不可）。★★ **前置查不到**：★ 官方页**无 `## Remarks` 段** ⇒ ★ 本工具**不编前置**（铁律 5），★ 只回读选区计数、★ `preconditions_held` 如实报 **None**。⚠ 该族另有 `IClosedCornerFeatureData` 指针路：★ 其 `IAccessSelections` 官方已标 `Obsolete` → 后继 `IAccessSelections2`；★ ★ 而该族是**进程内指针接口**，★ 本仓 pywin32 后端到不了（已知事实 47）⇒ ★ 本工具**只走直入法**、★ 不碰指针族。
specs.title: Sheet Metal Closed Corner

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_insert_end_cap
specs.doc: ★ **焊件顶端盖**：`IFeatureManager.InsertEndCapFeature3(10 参)` → `IFeature`。★★★ **官方前置（Remarks 逐字）**："Before calling this method, **select one or more end faces** of a structural member in the graphics area." ⇒ ★ 调用前必须在图形区选中端面；★ 本工具**不代选**（★ 面没有可用名字 —— 已知事实 32；★ 且规则 3 禁裸坐标），★ 只**回读选区计数**写进 `preconditions_held`。★ ★ 官方**这一句没给 mark**，★ 官方例子用的是 mark=**0** ⇒ ★ **与角撑板的 mark=1 不一样**，★ 两个入口的 mark 不能互相套用。⚠ ★★ `InsertEndCapFeature2`（7 参 · 末位 `System.object Faces`）**不是**废弃成员 —— ★ 官方页无 Obsolete 句、★ 且 Remarks 明写它是「用 Faces 数组」的**并列**入口 ⇒ ★★ **不是** `1 → 2 → 3` 的线性继承；★ 而它末位是**数组形参** ⇒ `Param` 表达不了 ⇒ 本工具不做。★ 判据 = **特征树增量** + 返回对象非 None + **`GetDefinition()` 属性回读**（官方例子读法）。
specs.title: Weldment End Cap

specs.name: solidworks_weldment_gusset_create
specs.doc: ★ **焊件角撑板**：`IFeatureManager.InsertGussetFeature3(20 参)` → `IFeature`。★★★ **官方前置（Remarks 逐字，本批最硬的一条）**："Before calling this method, you must call `SelectByID2` to select **two faces** that are the supporting legs of this gusset **with a Mark of 1**." ⇒ ★★ 必须选**两个面**、★ **mark = 1**（★ **不是 0**）；★ ★ 官方例子两次都 **Append=True 且 mark=1** ⇒ ★ 本工具照抄这个组合、★ `preconditions_held` 判的是「**mark 1 上 ≥ 2 个**」⇒ ★ 调用者能一眼看见「mark 1 上只有 1 个面」这种失败。⚠★ **接口别认错**：★ 这是**焊件**角撑板（`IGussetFeatureData`，官方描述 "Allows access to a **weldment** gusset feature."，14 属性 / 4 方法）⇒ ★ **不是**钣金那个 `ISMGussetFeatureData`（"Allows access to a **sheet metal** gusset feature."，28 属性 / 2 方法）⇒ ★★ 两者共有成员**只有 3 个**、★ 用错时**连读都读不到**（已知事实 36）。⚠ ★★ **官方在废弃链上断了一节**：`InsertGussetFeature`（15 参）**Obsolete** → 直接指向 `InsertGussetFeature3`；★ 而中间的 `InsertGussetFeature2` 的页**没有** Obsolete 句 ⇒ ★★ **别写「Gusset 三代线性链」** —— ★ 官方**没写**中间那代的废弃状态。★ 判据 = **特征树增量** + 返回对象非 None + **实体面数增量** + **mark-1 选区计数**。
specs.title: Weldment Gusset (Corner Gusset)

specs.name: solidworks_surface_midsurface_create
specs.doc: ★ **曲面中面**：`IFeatureManager.InsertMidSurface(4 参)` → `System.object`。★★ **官方前置（Remarks 逐字）**：`pPartDocIn` 是**该组件的模型文档**、`pBody` 是**该组件的体** ⇒ ★ 本工具**要求活动文档是零件**；★ 取不到体时**如实报** `preconditions_held=False` 并写明原因，★ **不猜**。判据 = **曲面体数增量**（官方逐字：每张参考面都算一个 **`sheet body`**）+ 返回对象非 None + 树增量（★ 后者单独**不足以**当判据）。⚠ 本工具**尚未真机验证**；★ 同批其余 4 条同样只是**已注册**，不是**已验证**。
specs.title: Surface Mid-Surface (by body index)

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_projected_view
specs.doc: ★ **投影/模型视图**：`CreateDrawViewFromModelView3`（经 `add_view`）。★★ **真机证据**：本工具**经工具层**实测返回真实视图对象（`CDispatch`）、★ 且**正是靠本地化名回退**建成（`*Front` 失败 → `*前视` 成功；known-facts 494）。⚠ **另有一条已知限制与本工具无关**：`create_standard_views_with_projection`（三视图布局那条路）在本机返回 `blocked / CreateFirstAngleViews2 / DRAWING_PROJECTION_API_UNAVAILABLE`（本机 COM 代理没有那个成员）⇒ ★ 该限制**未**挂成工具。
specs.title: Drawing Projected / Model View

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_section_view
specs.doc: ★ **剖面视图**：`CreateSectionViewAt5`。★★ **前置（官方 Remarks 逐字）：调用前必须先选好剖面线** ⇒ 本工具**不代选**，先回读选区计数并在返回值里给 `preconditions_held`。⚠ 真机该格**前置未成立**（选区为空）⇒ ★ **不能**据此判「剖面视图不成」（事实 496）。
specs.title: Drawing Section View

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_detail_view
specs.doc: ★ **局部视图**：`CreateDetailViewAt4`（官方 **12 参**）。★ 真机证据：视图数 **1→2**、返回非 None（证据 JSON 的 V3 格）。★ 前置：图上要有**局部圆（草图圆）**（官方例子的调用序：`ActivateView` → `CreateCircle` → 才调）。
specs.title: Drawing Detail View

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_set_sheet_format
specs.doc: ★ **图纸格式/模板**：**`ISheet.SetTemplateName(String NameIn)`**（官方 **`void`、未废弃**）。★★ **为什么不是 `SetupSheet6`**（★ 本 doc 原先写的是它，2026-10-03 更正）：`ISheet.SetTemplateName` 才是**换图框**的成员；`SetupSheet6` 是用来**新建/重置图纸**的（17 参）—— ★ 两者不是一件事。★★★ **而真机踩过一个坑**：能力层原先是 `sheet = GetCurrentSheet(); sheet.SetTemplateName(p)`（**直接属性访问**）⇒ 经工具层报 **`com_error: 找不到成员`**；★ 定点诊断（`output/_diag_sheetfmt.json`）证明**同一个成员、同一个对象**用 `get_com_member` 就成功（返回 `None` = `void` 成功）⇒ ★ 是**通道**问题、不是名字问题（known-facts 499）。★ 官方 Remarks 逐字：调完要 `ForceRebuild3` 才刷新第一角/第三角投影（★ 现已在能力层里补上）。★ 判据：`SetTemplateName` 回 `None` **且** `GetTemplateName` 回读等于新路径。
specs.title: Drawing Sheet Format / Template

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_add_note
specs.doc: ★ **注释/文字**：`InsertNote`。★ 真机证据：两格（选中 / 不选）都返回非 None，判据是注解读数增量（证据 JSON 的 A4 格）。★ 官方 Remarks 逐字：**引线附着点来自调用前做的选择**；**没有选中时**无引线、自由放置、在原点。
specs.title: Drawing Note / Annotation

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_hole_table
specs.doc: ★ **孔表**：**`IView.InsertHoleTable3`（9 参、未废弃）**。★★ **本工具改过实现**（2026-10-03 真机 e2e 实测的教训）：原先把 `InsertTableAnnotation` 当孔表入口 —— ★ 而官方签名逐字是 `InsertTableAnnotation(X, Y, AnchorType, Rows, Columns)`，**它没有任何参数说"这是孔表"** ⇒ ★ **它建的是通用表，建不出孔表**（e2e 实测：注解数 72→72）。★★★ **前置（官方 Remarks 的 mark 表，逐字）**：基准原点**顶点 mark 1** · 孔**边与面 mark 2** · X 向参考 mark 4 · Y 向参考 mark 8 ⇒ ★ 本工具**不代选**，先回读选区里 mark 1/2 各几个，`preconditions_held` 如实给出（★ 前置不成立时**不能**判「孔表不成」）。★ 真机证据：`output/drawing-batch-evidence.json` 的 A6 格（`GetTableAnnotationCount` 增量、前置成立）。
specs.title: Drawing Hole Table

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_create_revision_table
specs.doc: ★ **修订表**：**`ISheet.InsertRevisionTable2`（7 参、未废弃）**。★★ 同孔表：`InsertTableAnnotation` **建不出修订表**（它没有"表类型"参数）⇒ 走**真入口**。★★ 官方 Returns 逐字：**已有修订表时回 `null`** ⇒ ★ **第二次调用「回 null」是契约、不是失败**（★ 返回值里有 `raw_is_none` 供按契约解释）。★ 真机证据：`output/drawing-batch-evidence.json` 的 A7 格（两格都返回非 None）。
specs.title: Drawing Revision Table

specs.name: solidworks_drawing_insert_center_marks
specs.doc: ★ **中心符号线**（批量）：`AutoInsertCenterMarks2`。⚠⚠ **真机阴性已知**：单点入口 `InsertCenterMark3` 两格都**不成**，且其中**一格前置是成立的**（证据 JSON 的 A8 格）⇒ ★ 本工具走的是**批量**那条路，★ **尚未单独真机验证** ⇒ ★ 如实标注，**不许**当成「已验证」。
specs.title: Drawing Center Marks (auto, per view)

specs.name: solidworks_feature_cosmetic_thread
specs.doc: ★ **装饰螺纹线**：`IFeatureManager.InsertCosmeticThread3`（**7 参** · 官方 md **未标 Obsolete**）。★★ **官方前置（台账逐字）：选圆柱面的**一条边**（★ 不是那个面）** ⇒ ★ 本工具**自己找**：先用官方 `ISurface.IsCylinder()` 定位圆柱面、取它的第一条边并按 `mark=0` 选中 ⇒ ★ 调用方**不必**先选；★ 找不到圆柱面时**如实报** `preconditions_held=False` + 原因。★ **判据**：特征树**新增** + 返回对象 `GetTypeName2`（★ 真机建成时是 **`CosmeticThread`**、名 `装饰螺纹线1`）。★★ **真机证据**（已建成过，★ 但那是在**探针**里的读数）：`output/cosmetic-thread-evidence.json`（2026-10-03 轮 568，走 `sw_guard`、零弹窗）。⚠ 经**本工具**的端到端读数**尚未跑** ⇒ ★ 在那之前**不许**把它写成「经工具层已验证」。

specs.name: solidworks_sketch_spline
specs.doc: ★ **草图样条曲线**：`ISketchManager.CreateSpline2(data, False)`。★★★ **本条修掉了一个真 bug（★ 且是一处「被误记成架构限制」的假阴性）**：能力层 `scripts/sw_part.sketch_spline` **此前每次都抛**，其 docstring 断言「**本机实测建不出来**」并把原因归给 **事实 47/68 的 pywin32 架构限制**。★ 而真因是 **数组的包装形态**：✗ `array.array('d')` ⇒ **静默回 `None`**；✓ **`VARIANT(VT_ARRAY|VT_R8, 扁平 list)`** ⇒ **建成**（草图段数 0→1）。★ 证据：`output/spline-with-variant-evidence.json`（四格对照，`form=spline2` ⇒ `ok=true`）。★★ 而**正解早在本仓**：`scripts/sketch_relations.create_spline:272-273` 逐字写着「★★★ 必须包 `VARIANT(VT_ARRAY|VT_R8)` —— 裸 list/tuple 会**静默返回 None**（轮 183 实测）」⇒ ★ **同一个仓里两条路，一条修了、另一条从没跟上**。★ 前置（官方 Remarks）：**必须先有活动草图**。⚠ 经**本工具**的端到端读数**尚未跑** ⇒ ★ 在那之前不许写成「经工具层已验证」。

specs.name: solidworks_flatten_surface
specs.doc: ★ **曲面展平**：`IFeatureManager.InsertFlattenSurface2(AccuracyFactor, ShouldUseTears)`（**2 参**）。★★★ **官方前置（台账逐字）**：必须选中 **面（mark = 1）** 与 **锚点（mark = 16）**；★ 另可选 2 = 引导边 · 4 = 映射边 · 8 = 撕裂边。★★ 台账还逐字记着那组**四格对照**的结论：「**面-only（mark=1）不够**」⇒ ★ 本工具**自己两个都选**（面按 1、该体第一条边的一个顶点按 16）；★ 锚点没选上时**如实报** `preconditions_held=False` 并**指明**那正是失败原因。★ **判据**：特征树**新增** + 返回对象 `GetTypeName2`（★ 真机建成时是 **`FlattenSurface`**、名 `曲面-展平1`）。★★ **真机证据（探针级）**：`output/flatten-with-anchor-evidence.json`（2026-10-03 轮 556，走 `sw_guard`、零弹窗）。⚠ 经**本工具**的端到端读数**尚未跑** ⇒ ★ 在那之前不许写成「经工具层已验证」。

specs.name: solidworks_thicken
specs.doc: ★ **加厚 / 加厚切除**：**`IFeatureManager.FeatureBossThicken`（7 参）** / **`IFeatureManager.FeatureCutThicken`（6 参）** —— ★★ **两个都未废弃**。★★★ **为什么是这两个成员**（★ 本条的来历）：`IModelDoc2` 那份**同名**成员已废弃（`FeatureBossThicken2` 头顶逐字：`Superseded by [[IFeatureManager::FeatureBossThicken]].`），★ 而另一族 `IModeler.ThickenSheet` 造的是**片体、不是特征** ⇒ ★ 入口只有这两个。★★ **官方前置（Remarks 逐字）**：参考面**必须按 `mark=1` 选中**；`FillVolume=true` 时**其余参数被忽略**、且**必须闭合曲面**；切减时 `UseAutoSelect=false` 要**先选实体** ⇒ ★ 本工具**自己把第一张面按 `mark=1` 选上**，选不上就**如实报前置**。★ **判据**：特征树**新增** + 返回对象 `GetTypeName2`（★ 两条都报）。⚠ **尚未真机验证**（★ 由 `tools/probe_thicken_tool.py` 单独验）⇒ ★ 在那之前不许把它写成 `verified`。
